We need to call the function with location "Amazon rainforest" and time_frame "six_months". Then we will get result. Then call again for "year", then for "five_years".

But the user wants all three stats. We could combine them into one call if the function allowed multiple time frames, but it doesn't. So we need to call thrice. We'll do that.

Thus first response: call function ecology_data_precipitation_stats with location "Amazon rainforest" and time_frame "six_months".
